title: Playboy April 2008 WWE Diva Maria Kanellis Jenna Fischer Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Small white scuffs near the lower-right front edge, light corner and edge wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, April 2008. Original $6.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: WWE Diva Maria Kanellis.

Cover features: WWE Diva Maria Kanellis pictorial - Diva Maria shows us the ropes; 20Q with The Office's Jenna Fischer; flight attendants pictorial; exclusive excerpt from Kurt Vonnegut's last book; interview with Nickelback's Chad Kroeger.

Back cover: Stolichnaya vodka ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
